title: Piece Material -- Example Production
subtitle: A fabricated, invented example instance for the inscribe production format (issue #104); every term, question, interview, character, scene and line below is made up for this example and is not drawn from any real group, interview or production.

Waiting: Tell me about a time you were waiting for something and didn't know how long it would take.
Leaving: Describe the last time you left a place you weren't sure you'd return to.
Noise: What is a sound you can't get out of your head, and why?
A Key: Tell me about a key you once had and what it opened.

interviews.summary: An invented account of a long wait at a closed gate, and the small routines that made it bearable.
quotes: I counted the tiles on the ground until I lost count and started again.

interviews.summary: An invented account of leaving a shared flat, carrying a key that no longer opened anything.
quotes: I kept the key in my pocket for a month after I'd already given the other one back.

setting: A fabricated night bus station, between the last bus and the first.

characters.wants: to be relieved of the watching, but won't say so

characters.name: The Arriver
characters.wants: to find the key that was supposed to be left for them

arc: An invented arc: a long wait resolves into a small, unexpected departure.
